04 / A little about me

Background & approach

My background brings together mechatronics and artificial intelligence, with hands-on experience in applied research, electronics, and prototyping. I’ve tried a bit of everything—and I like how much there is still to learn.

I learn quickly and enjoy following a problem across disciplines: how a part fits, what a sensor detects, and what the code should do next. I don’t always know the answer at the start. Figuring it out is the part I enjoy.

Some projects here are finished studies. Some are still on the workbench. All of them have taught me something, occasionally through a very convincing demonstration of what doesn’t work. A little humor helps.
